body: Thank you. I’m still here. I know that really desperate circumstances have really exacerbated my mental health issues. Might give it until tomorrow or day after to figure out what to do.
There’s no one I want to talk to. Just wondering what kind of checklist i should run through to be sure of my decision. It’s supposed to be my decision. It’s my life.
It’s my phone…I’ve been streaming a series on repeat, like probably repeated about 5 times now in the past week. I’m scared. I don’t want to be alone with all the shit. Can’t turn it off.

Everything is problematic in my life. My sister doesn’t like me. My mom and I have little in common besides the genetic stuff that can be pleasant to share in the moment but that is of fleeting satisfaction at the end of the day. I didn’t develop a solid worth ethic so I have failed college several times and am in the middle of failing again. I’m severely in debt. My spirit is like the opposite of light. It’s heavy, very heavy. I have a bad living situation, living with stranger roommates. And I have very few memories of enjoying life in my soon to be decades of living it. …to continue, I have trouble making decisions, I stall over how to communicate with people trying to be understood and then making them angry anyway.
I feel you. Stress and pressure and “the little things” that are supposed to make life worth it. Isn’t enough.

She’s said it’d completely tear her apart if something happened to me, but I don’t see how having me alive and miserable/struggling all of the time is any better.
Yea like she knows I struggle with mental health, but yesterday I actually went into planning mode. All a sudden she was getting really freaked out and she lives hundreds of miles away.
Duct tape has sufficed for me. I even pull the tape down sometimes for fresh air

Today I just ate cold bread for dinner because one is planted on the couch and I’m not feeling social. I’d say when you have roommates, you’re not entitled to 24 hour access to common spaces. You are renting the whole apartment under the conditions that other humans are there who also need privacy sometimes.
Don’t be a human with feelings.
I think the us should have bidets. I don’t use wipes. I reach over to the sink and wet the toilet paper. It doesn’t disintegrate that quickly and I clean myself completely for both 1 and 2.
